text:
{collection}.{field}: personal to {person}, which is not a link field of {collection}.
person is "self" or the name of an nc.link field of {collection}.
when: Under the lock's name, when `ncdb model build` or `ncdb model check` refuses a model that breaks a rule on its own: a personal field's person is no link field of its collection. Opening with such a lock shows it after error.lockInvalid's colon.
